title: Add Markdown heading breadcrumb prefixes and short-section coalescing for comment embeddings

sections.what: Prepend full file + heading breadcrumb path to every Markdown section embedded comment text, and coalesce direct ### child summaries (up to ~350 tokens) into thin parent ## sections (< 60 tokens).
sections.why: Markdown comment chunks have a median length of 21.5 tokens (86 chars), causing child subsections to lose parent framing and thin parent sections to embed poorly.
sections.verify: Run pytest tests/test_codesearch_parsers.py verifying breadcrumb prefixes and parent-child coalescing.

acceptance.text: Every Markdown section embedded comment text starts with its full document + heading breadcrumb path.
Short parent ## sections (< 60 tokens) with ### children fold direct child summaries (up to ~350 tokens) into the parent comment vector.
Parser and embedding tests verify breadcrumb prefixes and coalesced parent comment text.
